# Hi, I'm Blaine

**I build what's missing, the way it should have been.**

I build what's missing, the way it should have been. 14+ years as a software engineer across real-time data platforms, infrastructure and mobile, and 25+ apps shipped on my own: Haven, a private post-quantum social network with no servers; Afterglow, open-source phone VR; Enter Space, cloud storage that feels local; Shepherd, a self-hosted home-network guardian. Much of it is free and open source. Away from the keyboard I photograph the night sky, giant sequoias and a very fluffy dog named Luma.
